item.title: Version 3.2.0
item.description:
Opening the help viewer on macOS crashed the program because wxwidgets tried to require libjpeg which conflicted with system libs.

Help on Linux was similarly broken expect that it just didn't display anything.

Gates are now rotated properly so a keypad gate can be rotated correctly now.

Toolbar icons are properly sharp on 125% and 150% displays instead of being rounded down and blurred thanks to @DavidDGTNT. On Wayland the app will properly utilize the graphics card with skia. The Linux build is now build on an older c version to allow running it on older distros & issues with libjpeg are now fixed. On macOS, running the app straight from the disk image now tells you to drag it to Applications first.

Sites that deploy CedarLogic through managed software can now switch update checking off for a whole machine:

```reg

HKLM\Software\Cedarville University\CedarLogic\WinSparkle

CheckForUpdates REG_SZ "0"

```

Full Changelog: https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl/CedarLogic/compare/v3.1.2...v3.2.0
